<DESCRIPTION>EXTENSION AGREEMENT BETWEEN VIRAL GENETICS, INC. AND LESLIE Z. BENET, EFFECTIVE JANUARY 1, 2011
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.41</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>EXTENSION AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>THIS CONSULTING AGREEMENT
</B>(the &quot;Agreement&quot;) is made and entered into effective the 1<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">st </FONT>day of January
2011 (the &quot;Effective Date&quot;) by and between VIRAL GENETICS, INC., a Delaware corporation (the &quot;Company&quot;), and
Leslie Z. Benet, an individual residing in the city of San Francisco, CA (&quot;Consultant&quot;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">(the &quot;Parties&quot;)</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">WHEREAS the Company and Consultant are party
to a Consulting agreement dated January 13, 2009 (the &quot;Agreement&quot;) and wish to extend the Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.6in"><B>NOW THEREFORE</B>, for
good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.6in"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">1.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The Agreement is extended until December 31, 2013 and shall automatically renew for additional
three-month periods unless otherwise mutually agreed to by the Parties in writing.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">2.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">All terms, conditions, representations, warranties and covenants of the Agreement and all Schedules
thereto shall continue in full force and effect including, without limitation, the Viral Genetics Intellectual Property Agreement
contained therein as Schedule B.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">Agreed to as of the date affixed hereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>
